decisions.reason: This articulated dumper remains a close extension of the core construction range, and after the firm has already invested in development and a public launch, management would be reluctant to reverse course without clear evidence of failure.

The compact telescopic loader line represents a highly visible multi-model commitment in the core business, so sunk investment, strategic fit and the need to justify the launch all favor continuation.
The material lift line is close to the established offer and is backed by explicit demand evidence from a large order and a long-popular model, making withdrawal very unlikely.

Although this underground mining loader is farther from the established range and therefore somewhat easier to cut, the dedicated launch and strong early operating results give management reasons to persist rather than abandon it quickly.
